fun.en: Aruba lies outside the main Caribbean hurricane belt, which is one reason it markets itself as a year-round sunny destination.
fun.zh: 阿魯巴位於加勒比海颶風帶之外，因此長年陽光充足，是熱門的全年度假勝地。

fun.en: Band-e Amir National Park has deep blue lakes held back by natural travertine dams, and it was Afghanistan's first national park.
fun.zh: 阿富汗的班迪阿米爾國家公園擁有被天然石灰華壩攔住的深藍湖泊，是該國第一座國家公園。

fun.en: Angola's Kalandula Falls is about 105 metres high and 400 metres wide, among the largest waterfalls in Africa by volume.
fun.zh: 安哥拉的卡蘭杜拉瀑布高約105公尺、寬約400公尺，是非洲水量最大的瀑布之一。

fun.en: Albania has roughly 170,000 concrete bunkers scattered across the country, built during the Cold War era.
fun.zh: 阿爾巴尼亞全國散布著約17萬座冷戰時期興建的混凝土碉堡。

fun.en: Andorra's only official language is Catalan, and its head of state is shared by the French president and the Bishop of Urgell.
fun.zh: 安道爾唯一的官方語言是加泰隆尼亞語，國家元首由法國總統與烏赫爾主教共同擔任。

fun.en: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai stands 828 metres tall and has been the world's tallest building since 2010.
fun.zh: 杜拜的哈里發塔高828公尺，自2010年起一直是世界最高建築。

fun.en: Aconcagua in Argentina, at 6,961 metres, is the highest mountain outside Asia.
fun.zh: 阿根廷的阿空加瓜山海拔6,961公尺，是亞洲以外的最高峰。

fun.en: The Areni-1 cave in Armenia holds the oldest known winery, dating back about 6,100 years.
fun.zh: 亞美尼亞的阿雷尼一號洞穴發現了已知最古老的釀酒坊，距今約6,100年。

fun.en: Nelson's Dockyard in Antigua is a Georgian-era naval dockyard that became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2016.
fun.zh: 安地卡的納爾遜船塢是喬治王朝時期的海軍船塢，2016年列入世界遺產。

fun.en: Australia is home to an estimated 40 million or more kangaroos, outnumbering its roughly 27 million people.
fun.zh: 澳洲估計有4,000萬隻以上的袋鼠，數量超過約2,700萬的人口。

fun.en: Vienna has repeatedly been ranked the world's most liveable city in the Economist Intelligence Unit's annual survey.
fun.zh: 維也納多次在經濟學人智庫的年度調查中被評為全球最宜居城市。

fun.en: Yanar Dag near Baku is a hillside where natural gas has burned continuously for decades.
fun.zh: 巴庫附近的燃燒山（Yanar Dag）山坡上，天然氣已持續燃燒數十年。

fun.en: Burundi shares Lake Tanganyika, the world's second-deepest lake at about 1,470 metres deep.
fun.zh: 蒲隆地與鄰國共享坦干伊喀湖，這是世界第二深的湖，深約1,470公尺。

fun.en: About 80 percent of the world's rough diamonds are traded through Antwerp in Belgium.
fun.zh: 全球約八成的鑽石原石經由比利時安特衛普交易。

fun.en: Benin is the birthplace of Vodun, and January 10 is a national holiday honouring the religion.
fun.zh: 貝南是伏都教的發源地，每年1月10日是紀念該宗教的國定假日。

fun.en: Ouagadougou hosts FESPACO, the largest African film festival, held every two years.
fun.zh: 瓦加杜古每兩年舉辦一次泛非電影節（FESPACO），是非洲最大的電影節。

fun.en: Bangladesh shares the Sundarbans, the world's largest mangrove forest and a home of the Bengal tiger.
fun.zh: 孟加拉擁有孫德爾本斯，這是全球最大的紅樹林，也是孟加拉虎的棲地。

fun.en: The Cyrillic alphabet is traditionally traced to 9th-century Bulgaria, and it became the EU's third official script.
fun.zh: 西里爾字母傳統上被認為源於九世紀的保加利亞，後來成為歐盟第三種官方文字。

fun.en: Bahrain's Pearling Path, tracing its pearl-diving history, was listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2012.
fun.zh: 巴林記錄採珠歷史的「採珠之路」於2012年列入世界遺產。

fun.en: The Bahamas consists of more than 700 islands and about 2,400 cays spread across the Atlantic.
fun.zh: 巴哈馬由700多個島嶼和約2,400個珊瑚礁小島組成，散布在大西洋上。

fun.en: Divers leap from Mostar's Old Bridge, roughly 20 metres above the Neretva River, in a tradition lasting centuries.
fun.zh: 莫斯塔爾老橋距涅雷特瓦河約20公尺，跳水者從橋上躍下的傳統已延續數百年。

fun.en: Białowieża Forest, shared with Poland, is one of Europe's last primeval lowland forests and shelters the European bison.
fun.zh: 與波蘭共有的比亞沃維耶扎森林是歐洲僅存的原始低地森林之一，棲息著歐洲野牛。

fun.en: Belize's Great Blue Hole is a marine sinkhole about 300 metres wide and 124 metres deep.
fun.zh: 貝里斯的大藍洞是寬約300公尺、深約124公尺的海底落水洞。

fun.en: Bolivia's Salar de Uyuni, about 10,000 square kilometres, is the world's largest salt flat.
fun.zh: 玻利維亞的烏尤尼鹽沼面積約1萬平方公里，是世界最大的鹽沼。

fun.en: Brazil holds roughly 60 percent of the Amazon rainforest, the largest tropical rainforest on Earth.
fun.zh: 巴西擁有約六成的亞馬遜雨林，這是地球上最大的熱帶雨林。

fun.en: Mount Gay Rum in Barbados cites a 1703 deed as proof of one of the oldest rum distilling operations.
fun.zh: 巴貝多的Mount Gay蘭姆酒以一份1703年的契據，主張自己是最古老的蘭姆酒釀造廠之一。

fun.en: Brunei's Kampong Ayer is one of the world's largest water villages, with thousands of residents living on stilts.
fun.zh: 汶萊的水村（Kampong Ayer）是世界最大的水上聚落之一，數以千計居民住在高腳屋中。

fun.en: Bhutan is carbon negative, absorbing more carbon dioxide than it emits, and its constitution requires 60 percent forest cover.
fun.zh: 不丹吸收的二氧化碳多於排放量，是負碳國家，憲法並規定森林覆蓋率須維持六成。

fun.en: Botswana's currency, the pula, means rain in Setswana, reflecting how precious rain is in a dry land.
fun.zh: 波札那貨幣「普拉」在茨瓦納語中的意思是「雨」，反映雨水在乾燥土地上的珍貴。

fun.en: Dzanga Bai in the Central African Republic is a forest clearing where hundreds of forest elephants gather.
fun.zh: 中非共和國的贊加拜（Dzanga Bai）是一片林中空地，常有數百頭森林象聚集。

fun.en: Canada has the longest coastline of any country, at more than 200,000 kilometres.
fun.zh: 加拿大擁有全世界最長的海岸線，超過20萬公里。

fun.en: In Switzerland it is illegal to keep just one guinea pig, because they are social animals that need company.
fun.zh: 在瑞士，只養一隻天竺鼠是違法的，因為牠們是群居動物需要同伴。

fun.en: Chile's Atacama is the driest non-polar desert on Earth, and some weather stations there have gone years without rain.
fun.zh: 智利的阿塔卡馬沙漠是地球上最乾燥的非極地沙漠，部分氣象站曾多年沒有降雨。

fun.en: China's high-speed rail network exceeds 45,000 kilometres, the longest in the world.
fun.zh: 中國的高速鐵路網超過4萬5千公里，是世界最長。

fun.en: The Basilica of Our Lady of Peace in Yamoussoukro is among the largest churches in the world.
fun.zh: 亞穆索戈的和平聖母聖殿是世界最大的教堂之一。

fun.en: Cameroon is nicknamed 'Africa in miniature' for its varied landscapes and more than 250 languages.
fun.zh: 喀麥隆擁有多樣的地貌與250多種語言，因此被稱為「縮小版的非洲」。

fun.en: The DR Congo produces roughly 70 percent of the world's cobalt, a key metal in rechargeable batteries.
fun.zh: 剛果民主共和國生產全球約七成的鈷，這是充電電池的關鍵金屬。

fun.en: Brazzaville and Kinshasa, separated only by the Congo River, are the two closest national capitals in the world.
fun.zh: 布拉薩市與金夏沙僅隔剛果河相望，是全球距離最近的兩座國家首都。

fun.en: The Cook Islands' Marae Moana marine park covers about 1.9 million square kilometres of ocean.
fun.zh: 庫克群島的「馬雷莫阿納」海洋公園涵蓋約190萬平方公里海域。

fun.en: Colombia has more bird species than any other country, with more than 1,900 recorded.
fun.zh: 哥倫比亞的鳥類超過1,900種，是全球鳥種最多的國家。

fun.en: The Comoros are among the world's leading producers of ylang-ylang, a flower used in perfumes.
fun.zh: 葛摩是全球主要的依蘭花產地之一，這種花是香水的重要原料。

fun.en: Cabo Verde's islands were uninhabited until the Portuguese arrived in the 15th century.
fun.zh: 維德角群島在十五世紀葡萄牙人抵達之前無人居住。

fun.en: Costa Rica abolished its army in 1948 and has used the savings for education and health.
fun.zh: 哥斯大黎加在1948年廢除軍隊，並將省下的經費投入教育與醫療。

fun.en: The bee hummingbird, the world's smallest bird at about 6 centimetres long, lives only in Cuba.
fun.zh: 世界最小的鳥「蜂鳥」體長約6公分，只生活在古巴。

fun.en: Blue Curaçao liqueur is flavoured with the dried peel of the laraha, a bitter orange grown on the island.
fun.zh: 藍柑橘香甜酒以島上的苦橙「拉拉哈」果皮調味。

fun.en: A cat buried alongside a human about 9,500 years ago was found in Cyprus, among the earliest evidence of cat domestication.
fun.zh: 賽普勒斯出土了約9,500年前與人類同葬的貓，是貓被馴化的最早證據之一。

fun.en: Czechs drink more beer per person than any other nation, at around 140 litres a year.
fun.zh: 捷克人均啤酒消費量全球第一，每年約140公升。

fun.en: Many sections of Germany's Autobahn have no general speed limit.
fun.zh: 德國高速公路有許多路段沒有一般性的速限。

fun.en: Lake Assal in Djibouti lies about 155 metres below sea level and is one of the saltiest lakes on Earth.
fun.zh: 吉布地的阿薩勒湖低於海平面約155公尺，是地球上含鹽量最高的湖泊之一。

zh: 多米尼克法語克里奧語

fun.en: Dominica's Boiling Lake is a flooded volcanic vent and one of the world's largest hot lakes.
fun.zh: 多米尼克的沸騰湖是被水淹沒的火山口，是世界最大的熱湖之一。

fun.en: The name LEGO comes from the Danish phrase 'leg godt', meaning 'play well'.
fun.zh: 樂高（LEGO）的名字來自丹麥語「leg godt」，意思是「玩得開心」。

fun.en: Santo Domingo's Colonial City, founded in 1498, is the oldest European-founded city in the Americas with a UNESCO listing.
fun.zh: 聖多明哥的殖民區建於1498年，是美洲最早的歐洲人建城並列入世界遺產的城市之一。

fun.en: Algeria is Africa's largest country by area, at about 2.38 million square kilometres.
fun.zh: 阿爾及利亞面積約238萬平方公里，是非洲面積最大的國家。

note: Export/partner values are from general knowledge of OEC/WITS/CIA data; direct page fetch was not possible (JS-rendered), so verified=false.
